title: Cute Coworker Christmas Gifts That Aren't a Mug
label: For Coworkers
intro: The coworker gift has one job: be nice without being weird. Skip the mug, they own eleven. A desk plant that can't die, pretty pens, hand cream for dry office air and a tiny candle land every time, and three of them fit in one gift bag.

images.alt: Shoppable collage on cream of a faux succulent, pastel gel pens, hand cream trio, small candle, pink sticky notes, tinted lip balms and a blush acrylic desk organizer.
Chin-down crop of a woman in a candy pink quilted vest at a farmhouse kitchen island, tucking a faux succulent and pens into small kraft gift bags with pink tissue.

items.name: Faux succulent in a ceramic pot
items.note: Cannot die. Believe me, people have tried.

items.note: Dry office air is a crime.
